chunk.content: Freshness of goldband goatfish (Upeneus moluccensis) is assessed by sensory, microbiological and chemical methods during storage in ice.
chunk.source_quote: OZYURT, G., KULEY, E., OZKUTUK, S., & OZOGUL, F. (2009). Sensory, microbiological and chemical assessment of the freshness of red mullet (Mullus barbatus) and goldband goatfish (Upeneus moluccensis) during storage in ice. Food Chemistry, 114(2), 505-510.

source.title: Sensory, microbiological and chemical assessment of the freshness of red mullet (Mullus barbatus) and goldband goatfish (Upeneus moluccensis) during storage in ice
